messages:
Micah Turner: Quick ThreePoint quarterly milestone check-in — need a short async sweep: what's shipped, what slipped, current owners, and any blocker calls.
Sasha Li: Shipped: threepoint-api v1.1 rolled to prod on 2025-03-15. Perf looks stable (95p ~220ms). Left two follow-ups: metrics dashboard and schema docs.
Erin Patel: Web UI is partial — feature flags on for 10% only. Main routing change slipped because of a refactor and e2e flakiness. ETA EOW if CR #423 merges and we clear one flaky test.
Omar Khan: I have CR `#423` up for review (https://git.redwood/threepoint/pull/423). I can pick it up tomorrow AM and push the fix. Won't block infra.
Nina Gomez: Infra/Dedicated: autoscale config validated in staging, load test green. Waiting on RBAC PR `#88` approval for prod rollout. Owner: Nina. Also need compliance sign-off for the network ACL change.
Micah Turner: I'll draft the compliance note tonight and own sign-off for the ACL doc. Thanks Nina.
Sasha Li: Callouts: 1) Analytics needs final event schema (they said Tue) — this blocks metrics dash. 2) Payments needs updated integration test harness (mock endpoints) — blocks e2e full pass.
Erin Patel: Payments mock endpoints: I left a TODO in the ticket. @Sasha, can you spare a couple hours to help wire the harness? Might save us a day.
Sasha Li: Yep, can allocate ~2 hrs tomorrow morning. Ping me in #eng-oncall to dovetail.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Prod deploy complete: threepoint-api v1.1 at 2025-03-15T18:02:00Z :tada:
Micah Turner: Next steps (compact): 1) Omar to merge CR `#423` + patch flaky test, 2) Erin finish e2e fix & flip FF to 50%, 3) Nina approve RBAC PR `#88`, 4) Sasha + analytics finalize schema. I'll drop the compliance note in this thread when done and update the OKR sheet.
Omar Khan: Will merge by 10:30 PT tomorrow and add the quick test fix.
Erin Patel: Targeting EOD for e2e fixes. Might ask for a 20min pairing session on one failing case.
Sasha Li: Two-hour block tomorrow AM works. If blocked, ping me and I'll join the pairing.
Micah Turner: If anything slips beyond EOW we'll mark partial ship for the OKR and call out rollback plan. Please react with :thumbsup: when you confirm owner/ETA.
Sasha Li: :thumbsup:
Erin Patel: :thumbsup:
Omar Khan: :thumbsup:
Nina Gomez: :thumbsup:
Micah Turner: Thanks all — I'll update the milestone row and note the follow-ups (metrics dash, schema, RBAC). If anyone needs to swap owners, reply here so I can reflect it in the tracker.
